title: NHRC urges govt to probe Meta’s funding of UNICEF amid CSAM investigation
summary:
In a letter to the Child Development Ministry, MHRC member Priyank Kanoongo wrote that "there is a concern" that UNICEF "which is supposed to work on the issue of CSAM while receiving funding from Meta, might end up serving Meta's interests".

The post NHRC urges govt to probe Meta’s funding of UNICEF amid CSAM investigation appeared first on MEDIANAMA.
llm_summary: The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) has asked the Indian government to investigate Meta’s financial support to UNICEF, warning that the partnership could compromise UNICEF’s work on child sexual abuse material (CSAM).
